Data and code for Brushett & Arthurs et al., 2026 - Life of the edge: industrial footprint and edge effects variably influence the spatial distribution of a boreal small mammal.
A working copy of this repository with full commit history can also be cloned from https://github.com/aidanbrushett/OSM_red_squirrel_distribution.
